content: Haramwo yela yoh le ibe hapatpat irel yalol sew mo sew fulu hare yalol angelus, iwe ngo hare tor depel hachangcheng irey, ila ngo meka ikapta ila tor loh pelal le ye wochog kkungul parang kowe rema hakkunguloh chog le tor loh pelal.

Hare isallap irel foloy ngo yesa yoh ngalyey pangal repiy ngo igula pangal mekla ye llebag, ngo ye kkel yai tugulul ladep la be yoh le ibe hamgudu sew tayit mo liliyal, iwe ngo hare be tor depel hachangcheng irey, ila ngo ngang ila tor loh pelay.
Haramwo ifangloh pangal meka litay, ngo ila mwo ifang mele holongoy bo rebe fisgi, iwe ngo hare tor depel hachangcheng irey, ila ngo tor mele ibe mmalli mo iyang.
Hachangcheng ila malulu mo momayel hagiyeg; hachangcheng ila te loltomay hare habos;
hachangcheng ila te tayikofel wegdeg, hare mele sima luwallel chog kofach llufulyach, hare hasong; hachangcheng ila tema hattey yal ssong.
hachangcheng ila tema rraey irel wegdeg tayikof, bo yema rraey irel meka ye katos.
Hachangcheng ila yema yedamgel chog luwul tugulul ladep, mo luglug, mo malulu.

Hachangcheng ila tema yug. Yor hapatpat kala yema hakkela depel yarmat. Iwe ngo ligdi bo be tor loh. Yor kkefang le hapatpat ka semat ye wel. Iwe ngo ligdi bo yebe tor loh. Yor repiy iwe ngo ligdi bo yebe tor loh.
Te pangal kkefang la be yoh le sibe medaf ngo ye yoh le sibe kapta mekla yalol Deus ngo yesa yoh ngalgich.
Bo yodla ye bela budoh mala ye hartael momay, ngo be chuyloh iye te yigil momay hemas.
Yodwe ichil yalwich, ngo yai hapatpat mo lal depey mo yai luluwal, ila ye wochog yael semal yalwich, iwe ngo igla le isa mel bo semal mal, ila itay wegdegel yalwich.

Meka si wiri igla ila ye wochog yongel formel lal pipiy le te yigil ffod; bela yodla ngo sibele moch la kalfengal mo Deus. Lepal golayey igla ila yete palleng: ibele moch la gola pangal loh, le be lepal yael Deus golayey.
Suluw formel le yebe mel chog: tugulul ladep, mo luglug, mo hachangcheng; ngo mala ye hartael palleng pelal mo luwul meka ila, hachangcheng.
